page.layout: One column of entries, each group headed by a year printed in the left margin beside it; a note in the right margin beside the 1387 group; a catchword at the lower right below the column.

main_text.l: 1387 | Wigboldus Everdts-sohn. Fœdus idem so-lenniter repetitum.

page.notes: The years 1385 to 1391 are printed in the left margin, each beside its group of names. The right-margin note is set in italic. Horizontal rules separate the year groups and are not transcribed. The catchword "Iarch" is printed in bold at the lower right. Spelling is kept as printed, including "Wigbolt Maurissingh", "Berwolt Calmar" and "Berwolt Calmer". The long s in the transcription is printed as s in the source, so the entries for "sohn" and "Paschedach" follow the printed forms.
